Retoob TV 0.6.1 preview 1

The default Algoplay collection now uses Profile B for all connector feeds. The publishers retain each source's video order, playback URLs, creator metadata, notes and distinct source occurrences.

The reader preserves exact, partial and unknown source dates, separate recommendation dates, and playback offsets. Attribution links can retain fragments such as GitHub line references.

Collection replacements carry hidden choices, saved card selection and direct subscription ownership to the B URLs. Already-followed replacements appear once. Hidden feeds remain individually restorable in Manage feeds.

Install over the existing signed preview. Existing direct feed URLs remain available.
